{{Quote|Luke, the beam isn't ''harming'' us! It seems to have... a ''different'' purpose.|Leia Organa|<ref name="TKS" />}}
The '''Keeper's beam''' was a powerful device controlled by [[The Keeper]]. It was not a weapon, but rather imparted knowledge to those struck by its light. It worked equally well on [[Species/Legends|organic species]] and [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The Keeper used this device during the [[Battle of The Keeper's World]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] to impart knowledge of its history and its [[Keeper's makers|creators]] to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].
